brief.objective: Produce the minimum safe implementation. Reuse existing code whenever possible.

instruction:
MISSION: FLEET_BRIDGE_IMPLEMENTATION

OBJECTIVE:
Implement the missing Fleet Bridge service.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Watch runtime/generated/fleet/requests/
- Automatically detect new requests.
- Invoke Claude Code for each request.
- Write the structured JSON reply into runtime/generated/fleet/responses/.
- Prevent duplicate processing.
- Support retries and timeouts.
- Start as a background service.
- Integrate with the existing Fleet protocol.
- Produce a Patch Plan before implementation.
